claim_scope: BOUNDED_D1_ONLY. Whatever this study returns is a statement about the D1 v1.2 classical-learner benchmark on its 128-case held-out-domain protected split and about nothing else. It licenses no statement about any language model, any scale, any second model family, or the successor experiment of issue #618.

attribution_of_predecessor_defeat.mechanism: the semantic orbit is information-neutral for TYPED_SERIALIZED_BAG (design matrices bitwise-equal up to one column permutation; renaming back reproduces the base fit bitwise), and on the same base feature dicts with no attack present, different multiclass solver families and pure column-order renamings each move 32 protected answers with equal training fit, on a matrix of rank 88 of 150 columns with 318 duplicate column pairs

parameters.information_source: the TYPED_SERIALIZED_BAG token multiset and sequence length; no label is read
parameters.corpus: train-union-dev serialized-bag feature dicts of the dataset variant being run; no protected-split instance enters the corpus
parameters.initial_colour: sha256('<path>|df=<df>')[:16], df = number of corpus instances containing the token; the raw value string never enters any colour
parameters.refinement_colour: sha256('<old colour>|<canonical neighbourhood>')[:16]; neighbourhood = multiset of co-present token colours over corpus instances, self excluded, canonicalized as ','.join(sorted(f'{colour}x{count}'))
parameters.features: {'sequence_length': n} plus 'prof:<colour>' = 1.0 per distinct corpus token present; corpus-absent tokens map to 'prof:unseen:<path>' (zero on every training row by construction)
parameters.model_grid: frozen d1_experiment.model_specs(); selection by (-dev_accuracy, complexity_rank, config_id); frozen run_arm public extension point; v1.2 runtime adapter (lbfgs logistic path)
parameters.dataset_source: frozen build_datasets() with the shipped manifest digest re-verified

companion_raw_guards.opportunities: protected cases whose raw serialized token multiset differs between BASE and the variant
companion_raw_guards.violations: protected answers that differ between the successor's BASE and variant runs

stability_battery.logistic_hyperparameters: C per frozen grid, max_iter=2000, random_state=2711
stability_battery.renaming_rule: zero-padded k%04d keys over the train vocabulary; test-only keys keep their names
stability_battery.scope: the whole frozen selection loop re-run under each probe, selection included

endpoints.E-INV: every companion guard holds with 0 violations over its denominator; SEMANTIC_ORBIT denominator must be 128
endpoints.E-STAB: every stability probe changes 0 protected answers
endpoints.E-PERF: BASE accuracy >= 0.75 - 1/128 = 0.7421875 and more than one distinct protected prediction

preconditions: PC-1 DATASET FIDELITY: the regenerated dataset reproduces the shipped manifest digest
PC-2 FROZEN MODULE INTEGRITY: the frozen hostile_representation_attacks twin digest verifies before anything runs
PC-3 NO FROZEN ARTIFACT MODIFIED: only additive files under src/orion/study/p9/, protocol/, evidence/
anti_tuning: K, hash, corpus, probes, endpoints and thresholds are fixed by this freeze before the first successor outcome exists; one execution; implementation defects land as a new dated freeze appendix, never as a parameter edit

differences: base-orbit correspondence verified through frozen build_orbit_map ground truth
stability re-probed with a hand-built dense design matrix (no DictVectorizer, no Pipeline)
guard denominators and violations recomputed from raw payloads and recorded predictions
independent_checker.disagreement_is: a defect, not a tie to break

environment_boundary.successor_runs_against: D1 v1.2, the only representation contrast P9 publishes
